attchmntText: Vibhor Steel Tubes Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Vibhor Steel Tubes Limited has announced an earnings conference call scheduled for Monday, November 23, 2026, at 3:00 PM onwards. The call will discuss the operational and financial performance for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026. The event will be conducted via a Diamond Pass link and universal dial-in numbers. Participants may RSVP to Fortuna PR. This intimation is filed in compliance with Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015. The company is formerly known as Vibhor Steel Tubes Private Limited. The notice was issued by Company Secretary Ms. Pallavi Aggarwal.

attchmntText: Vibhor Steel Tubes Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Vibhor Steel Tubes Limited filed a press release regarding financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a 91.55 percent year-on-year increase in net profit to Rs 2.72 crore for the second quarter. Operating income rose 26.99 percent to Rs 357.81 crore. EBITDA increased by 50.06 percent to Rs 14.13 crore. For the half year, net profit grew to Rs 4.65 crore. The growth was attributed to higher sales of value-added products from the Odisha plant. The company also incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary named Viyom Steel Infra Pvt Ltd. Crisil Ratings assigned a BBB+/Stable long-term rating to the company's bank loan facilities aggregating to Rs 370 crore.

attchmntText: Vibhor Steel Tubes Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Vibhor Steel Tubes Limited filed a notice with the Department of Corporate Affairs, BSE Limited, and National Stock Exchange of India Limited regarding a newspaper advertisement published on November 14, 2026. The advertisement, published in Financial Express and Jansatta, pertains to the Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. This filing is made pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The document serves to place the publication on record with the exchanges.

attchmntText: The company has informed about integrated Filing-Financial to stock exchange
voiceSummary: Vibhor Steel Tubes Limited approved its Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 during a Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026. The company reported a profit before tax of 364.62 Indian Rupees Lacs for the quarter and 626.14 Indian Rupees Lacs for the half year. Profit for the period was 272.45 Indian Rupees Lacs for the quarter and 465.39 Indian Rupees Lacs for the half year. Earnings per equity share stood at 1.44 for the quarter and 2.45 for the half year. Total revenue was 35,859.43 Indian Rupees Lacs for the quarter and 65,257.78 Indian Rupees Lacs for the half year. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board. Statutory auditors conducted a Limited Review of these financial results.
